item.title: Best Time to Visit Japan for Food Lovers 2026
item.description: Best Time to Visit Japan for Food Lovers: A Season-by-Season Guide to Regional Cuisine Japan is a country that eats with the calendar. This is a nation where chefs change their dishes not just by season, but by micro-season — where the arrival of bamboo shoots in April or the first sanma (Pacific saury) in September is front-page news.
